title: Community Media: Main Exam, 24 April 2019
department: Department of Journalism and Mass Communication
programme: Bachelor of Arts in Mass Media and Communication
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Describe five features of community radio.
Using a four-point criteria, differentiate between community and commercial media.
Compared to all other mass media, radio has emerged as the most popular mass medium in Africa. In a five-point argument, justify this assertion.
Identify and describe five key principles of community broadcasting.
With relevant examples from Africa, discuss five positive impacts of community media.
Explain five challenges facing community media in developing countries.
Describe the step-by-step process of setting up a community radio.
Explain five qualities of a good community media manager.
Name and describe five personnel involved in a community media.
Using a diagram, describe the organization structure of a community media.

programmes: Bachelor of Arts in Mass Media and Communication
